blog-post.description: A full article page. The headline, summary, hero image, author and date come from the page metadata; put the article body in the block's one cell, using headings to build the table of contents.
blog-post.html:
Blog Post

Choosing the right piece for your space starts with a few simple questions. This guide walks through them.

Measure first

Note the width, depth and height of the area, and leave room to walk around it.

Pick a material

Wood brings warmth, metal suits a modern room, and fabric softens a busy one.

Care and upkeep

Dust weekly, keep it out of direct sun, and clean spills straight away.
